findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The manual ware washing station was set up in the incorrect order. The sinks were as followed: wash, sanitize, rinse. The correct setup was discussed with the owner to ensure that dishes are getting cleaned properly. Sanitation should always be the last step of cleaning to be sure that the correct contact times are being met.
findings.citation_text: 4-703.11(A) Hot Water and Chemical. After being cleaned, equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be sanitized in: (A) Hot water manual operations by immersion for at least 30 seconds and as specified under § 4-501.111.

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events.
findings.comment: On arrival there is not a procedure available for cleaning up vomit/diarrheal events. A new copy of the procedure given by this department was distributed to correct.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored and used.
findings.comment: On arrival the CL based sanitizer in the unit are far to strong for safe use around food. The solution was diluted during this inspection to acceptable levels to correct.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment: Observed no sanitizer solution available for use. Sanitizer solution was made during inspection and tested at 200 ppm Cl-

findings.title: Proper hot holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Observed container of cooked pork temp at 125F. Pork was placed on stovetop, and reheated to 165F. 

3-501.16: (A) (1) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 135F or above. Roasts can be maintained at 130F or above.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.comment:
Observed utensils used for chicken in smoker to be stored on top of smoker and keg next to smoker. Utensils were moved during inspection. 

3-304.12: FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored: (A) in FOOD with their handles above top of FOOD and container (B) In non-TCS FOOD (C) On clean portion of FOOD preparation table or cooking EQUIPMENT as long as UTENSIL cleaned with proper frequency (Time/Temp Control Form). (D) In running water with sufficient velocity (E) In clean, protected location if UTENSILS are used only for FOOD not TCS (F) In container of water at least 135F and container is properly cleaned.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-702.11: UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be SANITIZED before use after cleaning. 
Observed operator wipe out crock with a towel. Operator was going to add food to crock directly after wiping it with the towel. Opportunity was taken to discuss with the operator the importance of properly cleaned and sanitized food contact surfaces. Operator put crock through 3 part wash process which was already properly set up.

findings.title: Proper hot holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: (A) (1) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 135F or above. Roasts can be maintained at 130F or above. 
Observed a portion of curry and a portion of red beans and rice to be below 135F. This is likely due to the food being cooked and transported without hot holding unit in the truck. Food temperature was raised to 165F and then held properly. Food will be served or discarded by six o’clock tonight. Suggest using coolers or hot box for transporting hot food items in order to maintain them at proper holding temperatures.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
2-201.11: (A) The PERMIT HOLDER shall require FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES to report to the PERSON IN CHARGE information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD. Report: Symptoms (all P except lesion), diagnosis (all P), and possible exposures (P). (E) Responsibility of food employee to report symptoms/disease to PIC.

Observed no employee health reporting agreements. Provided copy. Signed. COS.

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events
findings.comment:
2-501.11: A FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall have written procedures for EMPLOYEES to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT. The procedures shall address the specific actions EMPLOYEES must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of EMPLOYEES, consumers, FOOD, and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. Reference 2-501.11.

Observed no vomit/diarrheal policy for Norovirus. Provided copy. Facility has bleach to perform procedure. COS.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
7-204.11: (A)-(B): Chemical SANITIZERS applied for FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall meet regulatory requirements.

Observed incorrect bleach - no for food contact surfaces. Discussed with PIC. Inspector will follow-up on 8/10/21.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

Observed no bleach test strips. Only for quat. Provided samples. COS. Ensure to buy test strips.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114  (P) Observed chlorine sanitizer at *0 ppm in sanibucket.  Sanitizer solution was remade and tested at 200 ppm Cl-. Provide 50ppm to 200ppm chlorine concentration. Reference 4-501.114.

findings.title: Allergen training as required
findings.comment:
410 ILCS 625/3.07 Sec.. 3.07. Allergen awareness training.
(b) Unless otherwise provided, all certified food service sanitation managers employed by a restaurant must receive or obtain training in basic allergen awareness principles within 30 days after employment and every 3 years thereafter.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment: 5-205.11  (Pf) Hand washing sink blocked by **** . Hand washing sinks must be accessible at all times. Reference 5-205.11.
findings.citation_text:
6-301.12  (Pf) Disposable paper towels not provided at the hand washing sink. Provide disposable paper towels at hand washing sinks. Reference 6-301.12.
Observed a white bucket in handwash sink upon arrival and no paper towels at handwash sink. CFPM removed bucket and replaced paper towels. Inspectors informed handwash sinks must be accessible at all times.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114  (P) Chlorine sanitizer at 0 ppm in sani bucket and 3 compartment sink. Provide 50ppm to 200ppm chlorine concentration. 
Observed no chlorine in sani bucket, only soap/water. Inspectors informed to use a solution of chlorine and water only for proper sanitation.
CFPM was not using a sanitizing step at 3 compartment sink. Ensure Wash, Rinse, and Sanitize steps are used for all dish washing.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.citation_text:
3-501.16(A)(2) Observed fish filets and shredded cheese reading temperatures of 53 degrees. CFPM periodically shuts off generator, resulting in temperature abuse of TCS food. 

Inspectors informed CFPM that the generator needs to be on at all times to ensure food is cold held properly. Fish filets were discarded. Foods purchased at 11:30am (cheese and sour cream) are allowed to be kept for 6 hours before needing to be discarded.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.citation_text:
4-302.12  (Pf) A food thermometer is not available. Food thermometers shall be provided and readily accessible to ensure proper food temperatures. Reference 4-302.12.

Thermometer not available at unit. Provided during inspection.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.citation_text:
3-304.14  (C) In-use wiping cloths are not stored properly. Cloths used for wiping spills shall be maintained dry. Cloths used to wipe surfaces and equipment shall be held in proper sanitizer solution. Cloths in-use for wiping surfaces in contact with raw animalfoods shall be kept separate from cloths used for other purposes. In-use cloths must be laundered daily. Reference 3-304.14.
Observed wet wiping cloth on counter. Also observed disposable paper towel being used for multiple purposes.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.citation_text:
3-304.12  (C) In-Use Utensils are stored incorrectly in a container of cold, soiled water on the counter. Store in-use utensils: 1) in the food with the handle above the top of the food item; 2) on a clean and sanitized surface; 3) in running water; 4) in a container of hot water maintained at or above 135 °F. Reference 3-304.12. 

Created a TAC form for periodic washing/replacement of water.

findings.title: Allergen training as required
findings.comment: CFPM does not have required allergen training. Ensure CFPM completes ANSI accredited allergen training online before next inspection. Example: Servsafe is an online option. Keep certificate at the unit for future inspection.
